basic.name: Rock-It! Turret
basic.description:
Create a turret that deals 43~~0.04~~ damage. Loses Health over 20 seconds. 

Turrets prioritize the nearest enemy Hero when first created.

basic.name: Deth Lazor
basic.description: After 0.65 seconds, deal 175~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in a line. Heal for 30% of the damage dealt, increased to 75% against enemy Heroes.

basic.name: Xplodium Charge
basic.description: Place a bomb that deals 142~~0.04~~ damage to enemies within the target area after 1.25 seconds. Enemies hit are also Stunned for 1 second.

heroic.name: Robo-Goblin
heroic.description:
Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. 

Passive: Basic Attacks deal 100~~0.04~~ bonus damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

heroic.name: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
heroic.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

trait.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
trait.description:
Regenerate 1 Scrap every 4 seconds. Destroyed Rock-It! Turrets drop 1 Scrap, which can be picked up.

Activate to destroy a target Rock-It! Turret.

activable.name: Focus Turrets!
activable.description: Orders any nearby Rock-It! Turrets to focus the target.

activable.name: EZ-PZ Dimensional Ripper
activable.description: Activate to gain 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%, and reduce damage dealt by all nearby enemy Heroes and Summons by 50% for 3 seconds

level1.name: Rocket Boots
level1.description: Increase the cast range of Xplodium Charge by 30% and its damage by 35%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level1.name: Big Game Hunter
level1.description: Increase maximum Scrap by 2. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes, Mercenaries, or Monsters accelerates Reduce, Reuse, Recycle Scrap regeneration by 1.5 seconds.

level1.name: One Man Wrecking Crew
level1.description: Casting Basic Abilities cause Gazlowe's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds to deal 75% more damage. Stores up to 2 charges.

level4.name: Rock It Sock It
level4.description: Casting Rock-It! Turret grants Gazlowe a Shield that absorbs up to 200~~0.04~~ damage for 2.5 seconds.

level4.name: Hyperfocus Coils
level4.description: Heroes hit by Deth Lazor or Xplodium Charge take an additional 2% of their maximum Health in damage. Gazlowe is healed for 150% of the damage dealt.

level4.name: EZ-PZ Dimensional Ripper
level4.description: Activate to gain 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%, and reduce damage dealt by all nearby enemy Heroes and Summons by 50% for 3 seconds

level7.name: Goblin Fusion
level7.description: Generate 3 Scrap for each Hero hit by Deth Lazor.

level7.name: Overload
level7.description: Deth Lazor can now store up to 2 charges. Each enemy Hero hit by Deth Lazor reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level7.name: Master Blaster
level7.description: Deth Lazor and Xplodium Charge Slow enemies hit by 35% for 3 seconds. Rock-It! Turret Basic Attacks against enemies Slowed in this way extend the Slow duration by 0.5 seconds.

level10.name: Robo-Goblin
level10.description:
Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. 

Passive: Basic Attacks deal 100~~0.04~~ bonus damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

level10.name: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
level10.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

level13.name: Positive Reinforcement
level13.description: Primary Rock-It! Turret attacks against Heroes increase Gazlowe's Attack Speed by 40% for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Superior Schematics
level13.description: Rock-It! Turrets attack up to 2 additional enemies for 60% damage and have 30% increased Basic Attack range.

level13.name: Overcharged Capacitors
level13.description: Gazlowe gains 5% Spell Power for each active Rock-It! Turret, up to a maximum of 15%. Dealing Basic Attack damage heals Rock-It! Turrets by 8% of their max health.

level16.name: Firin' Mah Lazorz
level16.description: Firing Deth Lazor causes all of Gazlowe's Rock-It! Turrets to fire a Deth Lazor of their own that deals 125~~0.04~~ damage.

level16.name: Ark Reaktor
level16.description:
Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 2 seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates 3 miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for 3 seconds.

These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.

level16.name: Overklock
level16.description:
Basic Attacks grant Gazlowe 15% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

Dealing Basic Attack damage to Heroes causes them to take an additional 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.

level20.name: Mecha-Lord
level20.description: Basic Attacks increase Gazlowe's Armor by 10 for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 30, and deal 50% bonus damage to Stunned or Slowed enemies.

level20.name: Miniature Black Hole
level20.description: Increase Grav-O-Bomb 3000's radius by 25% and its damage by 50%. Each enemy Hero pulled reduces its cooldown by 12 seconds.

level20.name: It's Raining Scrap
level20.description: Reduce the Scrap cost of Rock-It! Turrets by 1. Regain 2 Scrap for each Scrap pickup.

level20.name: Bomb Toss
level20.description: Xplodium Charge cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds and launches 2 more bombs when it detonates.
